arguments.query: select c.charge_id,c.booking_id,c.idempotency_key,c.amount_cents,c.state,b.status from charges c left join bookings b on b.booking_id=c.booking_id where b.status is null or b.status!="confirmed"
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n,max(rowid) r from request_logs where status>=400 or status is null group by 1,2,3,4 order by r desc limit 15

select "nohold" k,booking_id,flight_id from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "nocheckin",booking_id,flight_id from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "charges",booking_id,count(*) from charges where state="captured" group by booking_id having count(*)>1 union all select "holds",flight_id,count(*) from holds group by flight_id union all select "nonconf",booking_id,status from bookings where status!="confirmed" union all select "outbox",status,count(*) from outbox group by status
select rowid,service,method,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 30

select "duprq" k,request_id a,count(*) n from bookings group by request_id having n>1 union all select "orphan",charge_id,state from charges where booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings) union all select "chgstate",state,count(*) from charges group by state union all select "badamt",c.booking_id,c.amount_cents||"/"||b.amount_cents from charges c join bookings b using(booking_id) where c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents and c.state="captured" union all select "nochg",booking_id,status from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured") union all select "dupcr",client_reference,count(*) from bookings where status="confirmed" and client_reference is not null group by 2 having count(*)>1
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 12
